narration.full_text: Namaste students! Today, we're diving into the fascinating world of the human nervous system and how our bodies react to different stimuli. We'll explore the rapid responses known as reflex actions and understand the intricate network that controls our every move and thought. By the end of this session, you'll have a clear understanding of how our nervous system functions. Let's start by understanding what reflex actions are and why they are so crucial for our survival. We'll also trace the pathway of a reflex arc, which is the neural pathway that mediates a reflex action. Then, we will identify the main divisions of the human nervous system, including the Central Nervous System, Peripheral Nervous System, and Autonomic Nervous System. Finally, we'll describe the components and functions of each of these vital divisions, comparing them to the hormonal system. Let's begin our exploration!
